decisions.reason: The $15,000 allocated-budget value does not necessarily change the wage-calculation rules or schedule; the JHS 157 schedule and support-sheet clauses are already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The allocated-budget value does not change the JHS 157 service-period dates, which are independently stated and already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The allocated-budget value does not alter the requirement for a Page 6 signature in the subcontractor section; that separate same-message clause is already present in the candidate history.
